client opens one `GET` SSE stream and submits operations via `POST` (carrying `extensions.operationId`), both passing the token in header `X-GraphQL-Event-Stream-Token` or query param `?token=` (`L70-84`, max 1 active SSE connection per token, `L75`); valid operations return `202 Accepted` while validation/request errors use normal GraphQL-over-HTTP `4xx` (`L79-80`); SSE events carry `{ "id": "<operationId>", "payload": ExecutionResult }` on `event: next` and `{ "id": "<operationId>" }` on `event: complete` (`L95-122`); client stops an operation via `DELETE ?operationId=<id>` with the reservation token (`L85-90`). | `third_party/specs/graphql-sse-v2.6.3/PROTOCOL.md:11-122`; `.../package.json:1-5` (`version: 2.6.3`) | `CONFIRMED` | `GQL-003`'s choice of `graphql-sse` distinct-connections mode over HTTP/2 is confirmed; note for `WP-M1-08` / `OPS-002` that (1) pre-execution validation errors on SSE requests MUST be emitted as `event: next` `{ errors }` + `event: complete` (`data: `) rather than HTTP `400`/`422`, and (2) accepting `Accept: text/event-stream` on `/graphql` in addition to `/graphql/stream` preserves compatibility with standard `graphql-sse` clients configured with a single endpoint URL. |

### (a.1) `Q-4` Supporting Breakdown — MCP `2026-07-28` `InputRequiredResult` to GAP `Task` `INPUT_REQUIRED` Field Mapping

Citations: `third_party/specs/mcp-2026-07-28/docs/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/mrtr.mdx:58-258`, `.../client/elicitation.mdx:44-148`, `.../schema/2026-07-28/schema.ts:537-609`, and `spec/02-gap-ql.md:122-133` (`Task`, `TaskStep`, `TaskEvent`).

| MCP `2026-07-28` Wire Field | Direction | GAP Internal / `gap-store` / GAP-QL Mapping (`CMP-013`, `ADR-016`) |
|---|---|---|
| `result.resultType == "input_required"` | Upstream MCP -> `gap-mcp` | Transitions `Task.state` and active `TaskStep.state` to `TaskState::INPUT_REQUIRED`; emits `TaskEvent { state: INPUT_REQUIRED, stepId, ... }`. |
| `result.requestState?: string` | Upstream MCP -> `gap-store` (opaque) | Stored verbatim in durable `TaskStep` continuation state (`gap-store`, tenant-scoped per `INV-09`); **never** exposed to untrusted prompt channels and echoed byte-for-byte in `params.requestState` on resume (`mrtr.mdx:76,120`). |
| `result.inputRequests[key]` where `method == "elicitation/create"` and `params.mode == "form"` (`message`, `requestedSchema`) | Upstream MCP -> `TaskStep.result` / `TaskEvent` | Sanitized (`SEC-080`, spotlighted if T2 per `CMP-007`) and surfaced in `TaskStep.result` / `TaskEvent.message` as structured input prompt `{ kind: "mcp_elicit_form", key, message, requestedSchema }`. |
| `result.inputRequests[key]` where `method == "elicitation/create"` and `params.mode == "url"` (`message`, `url`) | Upstream MCP -> `Task` state | Validated (`https://` scheme, never auto-opened per `SEC-080`); mapped to `TaskState::AUTH_REQUIRED` (when OAuth/credential consent) or `TaskState::INPUT_REQUIRED` with `{ kind: "mcp_elicit_url", key, message, url }`. |
| `result.inputRequests[key]` where `method == "sampling/createMessage"` | Upstream MCP -> `gap-mcp` | **Refused by default (`CMP-013`):** outbound `gap-mcp` omits `sampling` from `_meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities"]` (`mrtr.mdx:246`). If an upstream server still sends it while `mcp.allow_sampling == false`, `gap-mcp` resumes immediately with a JSON-RPC error object (`code: -32601` or `-32602`) in `params.inputResponses[key]` or fails the step (`NgcError::UPSTREAM_ERROR`), never invoking an LLM. |
| `result.inputRequests[key]` where `method == "roots/list"` | Upstream MCP -> `gap-mcp` | Outbound `gap-mcp` omits `roots` from `clientCapabilities` by default (`Q-5`); if explicitly configured for a sandboxed local connector, responds with configured static root URIs (`[]` otherwise). |
| Caller supplies input via `gap_task{action:"decide"\|"submit", id, input}` / `submitTask` / A2A `SendMessage(taskId)` | Caller -> `gap-mcp` -> Upstream MCP | `gap-mcp` issues a **new** JSON-RPC request (fresh `id`) with the stored original `method` (`"tools/call"`), original `params.name` and `params.arguments`, stored `params.requestState`, and `params.inputResponses: { [key]: ElicitResult { action: "accept" \| "decline" \| "cancel", content?: ... } }`. |

### (a.2) `Q-11` Supporting Breakdown — Complete `TaskState` Mapping Table (`A2A v1.0.1` vs `ADR-016` / `spec/02-gap-ql.md:34`)

Citations: `third_party/specs/a2a-v1.0.1/specification/a2a.proto:187-208`, `.../docs/specification.md:198-216,1213-1222`.

| `a2a.proto` Enum Identifier | Proto Tag | A2A JSON Wire Spelling (`ProtoJSON`, §5.5) | A2A Lifecycle Category | `ADR-016` / `spec/02-gap-ql.md:34` `TaskState` | Status / Discrepancy Flag |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| `TASK_STATE_UNSPECIFIED` | `0` | `"TASK_STATE_UNSPECIFIED"` | Indeterminate / default zero value | *(none)* | **EXTRA IN A2A (missing in `ADR-016`):** GAP never emits `0`; inbound/outbound `gap-a2a` must reject `TASK_STATE_UNSPECIFIED` as a malformed/protocol-error state. |
| `TASK_STATE_SUBMITTED` | `1` | `"TASK_STATE_SUBMITTED"` | Active (non-terminal) | `SUBMITTED` | **PREFIX DIFFERS:** strip/prepend `TASK_STATE_` (contradicts `CMP-021` `"State names map identically"`). |
| `TASK_STATE_WORKING` | `2` | `"TASK_STATE_WORKING"` | Active (non-terminal) | `WORKING` | **PREFIX DIFFERS:** strip/prepend `TASK_STATE_`. |
| `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` | `3` | `"TASK_STATE_COMPLETED"` | **Terminal** | `COMPLETED` | **PREFIX DIFFERS:** strip/prepend `TASK_STATE_`. |
| `TASK_STATE_FAILED` | `4` | `"TASK_STATE_FAILED"` | **Terminal** | `FAILED` | **PREFIX DIFFERS:** strip/prepend `TASK_STATE_`. |
| `TASK_STATE_CANCELED` | `5` | `"TASK_STATE_CANCELED"` | **Terminal** (single `L`) | `CANCELED` | **PREFIX DIFFERS:** strip/prepend `TASK_STATE_` (root spelling `CANCELED` matches). |
| `TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED` | `6` | `"TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED"` | **Interrupted** (pauses execution; resumable via `SendMessage` with `taskId`) | `INPUT_REQUIRED` | **PREFIX DIFFERS:** strip/prepend `TASK_STATE_`. |
| `TASK_STATE_REJECTED` | `7` | `"TASK_STATE_REJECTED"` | **Terminal** | `REJECTED` | **PREFIX DIFFERS:** strip/prepend `TASK_STATE_`. |
| `TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED` | `8` | `"TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED"` | **Interrupted** (out-of-band auth required; resumable) | `AUTH_REQUIRED` | **PREFIX DIFFERS:** strip/prepend `TASK_STATE_`. |

*Missing from A2A relative to `ADR-016`:* **None** (all 8 `ADR-016` states have exact semantic counterparts `1..8` in `a2a.proto`).
*Extra in A2A relative to `ADR-016`:* **`TASK_STATE_UNSPECIFIED = 0`**.

## (c) Differences `2025-11-25` -> `2026-07-28` That Matter to GAP (Outbound & Compat Window)

Citations: `third_party/specs/mcp-2026-07-28/docs/specification/2026-07-28/changelog.mdx:10-108`, `.../deprecated.mdx:12-41`, `.../basic/versioning.mdx:132-183`, `.../basic/transports/streamable-http.mdx:650-688`, `.../basic/transports/stdio.mdx:121-150`, and `third_party/specs/mcp-2025-11-25/docs/specification/2025-11-25/basic/{lifecycle,transports}.mdx`.

| Dimension | MCP `2025-11-25` (stateful legacy) | MCP `2026-07-28` (stateless pinned baseline) | Impact on GAP (`gap-mcp` outbound `CMP-010..014` & `/mcp` compat `CMP-001`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Connection / lifecycle** | Mandatory `initialize` request -> `InitializeResult` -> `notifications/initialized` before any tool/resource call (`lifecycle.mdx:38-151`). | **Removed.** Every request is self-contained; servers MUST implement `server/discover` (`DiscoverResult`, `discover.mdx:18`). | Outbound `gap-mcp` must branch per era: probe `2026-07-28` first (`server/discover` on `stdio`; modern `POST` checking `-32020..-32022` on HTTP `400`), falling back to `initialize` + `notifications/initialized` for `2025-11-25`. Inbound `/mcp` dispatches `2025-11-25` iff opening method is `initialize`. |
| **Session ID (`MCP-Session-Id`)** | Server MAY return `MCP-Session-Id` on `InitializeResult`; client MUST echo it on all HTTP requests, re-initialize on `404`, and `DELETE` on close (`transports.mdx:186-225`). | **Removed.** No `MCP-Session-Id` header exists (`streamable-http.mdx:681-682`). | Outbound `gap-mcp` maintains a per-branch session state machine (with `404` auto-reinit and `DELETE` teardown) **only** for `2025-11-25` HTTP servers; `2026-07-28` calls are completely lock-free/stateless. |
| **Version & capability negotiation** | Negotiated once inside `initialize` params/result; echoed in `MCP-Protocol-Version: 2025-11-25` on HTTP (`transports.mdx:264-281`). | Sent on **every request** in `params._meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion"]` and `params._meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities"]` (+ `MCP-Protocol-Version: 2026-07-28` on HTTP); mismatch returns `-32022` (`versioning.mdx:13-67`). | Outbound `gap-mcp` injects `_meta` on every `2026-07-28` request (with `sampling` & `roots` omitted unless explicitly enabled, `CMP-013`). |
| **HTTP methods & routing headers** | `POST` (messages), `GET` (standalone SSE stream + `Last-Event-ID` resumption), `DELETE` (session termination) (`transports.mdx:76-262`). | **`POST` only** (`GET` and `DELETE` -> `405`; `Last-Event-ID` removed). Client MUST send `Mcp-Method: <method>` on all requests and `Mcp-Name: <name\|uri>` on `tools/call`, `resources/read`, `prompts/get`; mismatch -> HTTP `400` + `-32020` `HeaderMismatchError` (`streamable-http.mdx:282-322,597-630,683-686`). | Outbound `gap-mcp` MUST set `Mcp-Method` and `Mcp-Name` on every `2026-07-28` HTTP `POST` (omitting them or ignoring non-echo on `2025-11-25`), and inbound `/mcp` MUST enforce `-32020` header matching on `2026-07-28` requests. |
| **Result envelope & caching metadata** | Results (`ListToolsResult`, `CallToolResult`, `ReadResourceResult`, etc.) have no `resultType`, `ttlMs`, or `cacheScope`. | **Every** `Result` requires `resultType: "complete" \| "input_required"`; discovery/list/read results (`server/discover`, `tools/list`, `resources/list`, `resources/templates/list`, `resources/read`, `prompts/list`, `prompts/get`) **require** `ttlMs: number` (`>= 0`) and `cacheScope: "public" \| "private"` (`caching.mdx:13-22,60`). | Outbound `gap-mcp` decoder treats absent `resultType` as `"complete"` in `2025-11-25` mode and requires `resultType` in `2026-07-28` mode; inbound `/mcp` MUST emit `resultType`, `ttlMs`, and `cacheScope` on `2026-07-28` responses. |
| **Server->client interactions (elicitation, sampling, roots)** | Server sends bidirectional JSON-RPC requests (`elicitation/create`, `sampling/createMessage`, `roots/list`) over `stdio` or HTTP SSE; URL elicitation also had `elicitationId` and `notifications/elicitation/complete`. | **Replaced by MRTR (`mrtr.mdx:58-258`):** server returns `InputRequiredResult { resultType: "input_required", inputRequests, requestState }`; client resumes with a new request carrying `inputResponses` + `requestState`. `Roots` and `Sampling` are **deprecated** (`earliest removal 2027-07-28`); `elicitationId` and `notifications/elicitation/complete` removed. | For `2026-07-28`, `gap-mcp` maps `InputRequiredResult` to GAP `Task` `INPUT_REQUIRED` (`Q-4`). For `2025-11-25`, `gap-mcp` refuses server-initiated `sampling/createMessage` JSON-RPC requests (`CMP-013`) and maps `elicitation/create` to `INPUT_REQUIRED` if supported or returns `-32601`. |
| **Cancellation** | Both `stdio` and Streamable HTTP send `notifications/cancelled { requestId, reason? }` (`2025-11-25/.../transports.mdx:128-129`). | **`stdio` only** sends `notifications/cancelled`; on Streamable HTTP, **closing the HTTP/SSE stream** cancels the in-flight request (`2026-07-28/.../cancellation.mdx:39-43`). | Fixes `CMP-012` (`Q-8`): `gap-mcp` aborts the HTTP response stream on `2026-07-28` HTTP, sends `notifications/cancelled` on `stdio`, and sends `notifications/cancelled` + drops stream on `2025-11-25` HTTP. |
| **Subscriptions, logging & `ping`** | `resources/subscribe` + `resources/unsubscribe`, ambient `notifications/*/list_changed` on GET SSE/`stdio`, `logging/setLevel`, `notifications/roots/list_changed`, and `ping` exist. | `resources/subscribe`, `resources/unsubscribe`, `logging/setLevel`, `notifications/roots/list_changed`, and `ping` **removed**. Opt-in `subscriptions/listen` POST stream carries `list_changed`/`updated` notifications (`subscriptions.mdx:14-95`); deprecated logging uses per-request `_meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel"]` (`logging.mdx:18-45`). | GAP 1.0 uses jittered + backoff polling for `tools/list` drift (`CMP-014`, `ING-052`, `Q-9`), does not use `ping` or `resources/subscribe`, and ignores `logging/setLevel` on `2026-07-28`. |
| **Tool execution error reporting & JSON Schema** | Tool execution errors use `CallToolResult { isError: true, content }` (refined guidance); JSON Schema dialect unspecified -> 2020-12 transition. | Explicit split between protocol errors (JSON-RPC `error`) and tool execution errors (`resultType: "complete", isError: true`); JSON Schema defaults to **Draft 2020-12** (`tools.mdx:215-225,495-560`). | Matches `CMP-004` / `CMP-011` (`jsonschema 0.60.1` in workspace supports Draft 2020-12). |
